## Valid Inputs

### Search by Phone (`input.ant-input[type="tel"][placeholder="Search by Phone"]`)

Per BRD §6 Rule 16 — substring match on `User.phone` only.

| Field | Valid Values | Notes |
|-------|-------------|-------|
| Phone (full) | Any 10-digit numeric string matching a known UAT buyer (e.g. `9876543210`) | Test fixture must be seeded |
| Phone (substring) | Any 3+ digit numeric substring of a known buyer phone (e.g. `987654`) | Substring match behavior |

### Filter — Allocation Status (`allotmentStatus` API param)

Per BRD §6 Rule 19. Comma-separated multi-select allowed.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| Registered | `registered` |
| Booked Online | `booked_online` |
| Booked Offline | `booked_offline` |
| Waitlisted | `waitlisted` |
| Cancelled/Refunded | `refunded` |
| Alloted | `alloted` |

### Filter — Payment (`paymentStatus` API param)

Case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| Paid | `Paid` |
| Pending | `Pending` |

### Filter — KYC / Process Status (`kycStatus` API param)

Case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19.

| UI Label | API Value |
|----------|-----------|
| KYC Completed | `KYC Completed` |
| KYC Pending | `KYC Pending` |

### Filter — Home Loan (`hasHomeLoan` API param)

Per BRD §6 Rule 18 — completion-status only.

| UI Label | API Value | Backend Evaluation |
|----------|-----------|--------------------|
| Yes | `true` | `HomeLoan.status='completed'` |
| No | `false` | `HomeLoan.status IN ('in_progress', NULL)` |

### Filter Values (Negative — case sensitivity)

| Field | Invalid Value | Expected Result |
|-------|--------------|----------------|
| paymentStatus | `paid` (lowercase) | API rejects or returns unfiltered (case-sensitive per BRD §6 Rule 19) |
| paymentStatus | `PAID` (uppercase) | Same as above |

| allotmentStatus | `Allocated` (wrong term) | Not in accepted list — rejected/ignored |
| allotmentStatus | `allocationStatus` (wrong param name) | Backend ignores; full result returned |

## LSQ Manual Gate — Cancel Unit Submit-Path

**Affects:** TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034b, TC_CUSTOMERS_E2E_049, TC_CUSTOMERS_REG_056 (when precursor is WF_034b)

Per CLAUDE.md Constraint #1, LeadSquared is excluded from this framework — no credentials, no API calls. The Cancel Unit Submit button on `customers-cancel-unit-modal.png` requires the **Mavis (LSQ) booking entry to be deleted first** before the second checkbox ("Mavis - Booking entry deleted") truthfully reflects upstream state. Submit is admin-attestation gated: both boxes must be ticked, and ticking the Mavis box without actual LSQ cleanup is a data-integrity violation.

### Required pre-step for any Cancel Unit Submit-path automation
1. Test runner identifies target Registration No (e.g. `GHNG-1000008563-AT`) and Unit code
2. **Test pauses** and notifies the user with the exact Registration No / Unit
3. User manually deletes the Mavis booking entry for that registration in LSQ
4. User confirms cleanup is complete (explicit confirmation — typed input or fixture flag)
5. Only then does automation tick both boxes and click Submit

### Recommended Playwright pattern
```javascript
// In customers.spec.js
test.skip(process.env.ENV === 'uat' && !process.env.LSQ_PRECLEAN_CONFIRMED,
  'Cancel Unit Submit-path requires manual LSQ Mavis cleanup first — set LSQ_PRECLEAN_CONFIRMED=1 after manual cleanup');
```

Or split into a manual-gated suite under `tests/manual-gated/admin/customers-cancel-unit.spec.js` that is excluded from default `npm run test:e2e:admin` runs.

### Read-only variants run unconditionally on UAT
- TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034 (open + assert + dismiss via Cancel button) — fully automatable on UAT
- TC_CUSTOMERS_NEG_035 (Submit disabled state matrix) — fully automatable on UAT
- TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_036 (open + assert + close X) — fully automatable on UAT
- TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_039 (open + assert + close X) — fully automatable on UAT

## Cleanup / Teardown

| TC | Cleanup action |
|----|----------------|
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034 (read-only) | Dismiss modal via Cancel button — no DB state change |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_034b / E2E_049 (Submit-path) | **Permanent — no undo per BRD §6 Rule 3.** Use a one-off seeded test booking that is acceptable to destroy. Document the cancellation in test-run notes. Re-seed before next regression. |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_NEG_035 | Dismiss modal via Cancel button |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_036 (read-only) | Dismiss modal via close X — no DB state change |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_036b / E2E_050 (Submit-path) | **Permanent — ₹999 refund recorded.** Use a one-off seeded test registration. Reconcile refund in test ledger. Re-seed before next regression. |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_039 (read-only) | Close modal via close X — no DB state change |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_WF_039b (Submit-path) | If toggle was switched, switch it back at end of test via the same modal (or use a reversible test row dedicated to this TC). Note: change applies to ALL related registration units. |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_FUNC_040 / TC_CUSTOMERS_FUNC_041 (Download) | Delete downloaded `RegistrationData.xlsx` from local download folder |
| TC_CUSTOMERS_BIZ_005 (Cross-module Config toggle) | After test, toggle the modified tower back to its original state in Config |
| Filter-applied TCs | Click "Reset Filters " button at end of test to restore baseline state |
| Search by Phone TCs | Clear the search input at end of test |
| Cancel Bulk Units (TC_CUSTOMERS_FUNC_043) | Dismiss any opened bulk modal without committing |
| Kebab dropdowns (TC_CUSTOMERS_UI_037, UI_038) | Press Escape or click outside to close dropdown |

## Browser Network Notes (for API-level assertion)

Per BRD §6 Rule 19 and INDEX.md API/Network Notes:

- Customer list endpoint: `GET https://uat-api.xrportal.in/api/v1/admin/dashboard/all-buyers?isDownload=0&page=1&limit=10&globalSearch=<query>&registrationDetails=<colSearch>`
- Composite IDs: `GHNG-NNNNNNNNNN-X`
- `globalSearch` param = phone-only substring (per Rule 16)
- Filter dropdowns are server-side — verify outgoing query params:
  - `allotmentStatus` (NOT `allocationStatus`)
  - `paymentStatus` (case-sensitive)
  - `kycStatus` (case-sensitive)
  - `hasHomeLoan=true|false`
- Download triggers `isDownload=1` query param — removes pagination but preserves `where[Op.and]` filter conditions
- KPI endpoint (`adminKpi`) — separate aggregate query, does NOT honor table filters; does NOT include `allotedCount` field (dead code per Rule 17)
- Default `projectId` substitution: UAT = 2, prod = 1 (Backend Gap GAP-DEV-001)
